title: Pip Finds Nell
note: b414 — Phase 3, consonants x, y, z added.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow standing on the edge of a wooden window box full of plants.
Pip spotting a small brown seed resting on the edge of the window box.
Pip the sparrow picking up the small brown seed in his beak.
Pip hopping further along the window box and spotting another small brown seed.
Pip the sparrow picking up the second brown seed in his beak.
Pip hopping right to the end of the window box and finding a small clay plant pot.
Nell the bee sitting inside the small clay plant pot, looking up at Pip.
Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee sitting together on the edge of the window box.
